question: Which fuel source's decline explains most of the US CO2 reduction since 2005? (A) Coal (B) Oil (C) Natural gas. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate stacked_bar chart. All segments are drawn in near-identical blues. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): ineffective color scheme. True answer: A (A). Bait: B (B).
